title: What if the Moon vanished tonight?

scenes.text: What if the Moon vanished tonight?
First, the nights would get much darker. No full moon, ever again.
The tides would shrink to less than half their size, because only the Sun would be tugging on the oceans.
Corals that time their spawning to the Moon would lose their calendar.
And over millions of years, Earth's tilt could swing wildly, scrambling the seasons.
That rock in the sky is quietly keeping our planet steady. Follow for more what ifs.
